eps.t: The Witch and the Love Potion of Unrequited Love
eps.ov: The Witch of the Lake, Rose, falls for a knight, who later visits her seeking a love potion.

eps.t: The Good Witch of the Lake
eps.ov: Rose finds herself being conscious of her looks while Harij begins to wonder about her disheveled lifestyle.

eps.t: The Black Tea Scented Witch's Song
eps.ov: With every visit, Harij helps Rose realize things she's overlooked before. Even of a certain song she sings.

eps.t: A Knight's Duty Even Unknown to the Witch
eps.ov: Harij continues to feel pressured to accomplish his mission, though something inside himself begins to change.
As time passes, Rose begins to realize the impact Harij is having on her life. However, to live as a witch...

eps.t: The Witch and the Promised Love Potion
eps.ov: With the potion complete, Rose explains to Harij how to use it, when he makes a shocking request to test it.

eps.t: The One to Cast a Spell on the Princess Is a Witch
eps.ov: With only one month before her wedding, Billaura took Harij's word to heart and decided to make a bold move.
Finding it hard to believe that Rose ever gets to rest, Harij takes it upon himself to make sure she sleeps.
